tour.welcomeBody: This is an interactive design preview. Try the sample bill, change a price and find your preferred language.
tour.micBody: Tap the pink mic for hands-free. Hold to talk, or slide up to lock. Live transcription arrives in Phase 6.
tour.swipeBody: Swipe left to remove a bill line, right to edit. Long-press for a price, or tap a quantity. Undo is always nearby.
tour.listen: A little help, in your language.
tour.listenBody: Listen buttons show a read-aloud text preview for now. Choose Hindi or Tamil to check script spacing. Spoken guidance arrives in Phase 6.
